scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npm run js && npm run html && npm run copy
scripts.js: mkdir -p dist/assets/js && terser assets/js/theme-script.js -c -m -o dist/assets/js/theme-script.js && terser assets/js/theme-plugin.js -c -m -o dist/assets/js/theme-plugin.js
scripts.copy: cp -R assets/css dist/assets/ && cp -R assets/images dist/assets/ && cp -R assets/fonts dist/assets/
